requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Arresting agency and arrest date tied to the DNA collection
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Arresting agency and arrest date tied to the DNA collection
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no participant arrest or DNA-collection record is held
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the agency and date from the arrest and DNA records; confirm it with the arresting agency and the participant's criminal-history record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case court, county, case number, and disposition date
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case court, county, case number, and disposition date
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no participant case record is held
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: all identifiers exactly as the certified disposition states them; confirm it with the clerk of the court that disposed of the case

requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform does not hold a complete criminal history and cannot certify eligibility
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: confirmation that no disqualifying prior felony conviction or pending felony charge for which DNA collection is authorized exists; confirm it with the participant's complete criminal-history records and New Mexico counsel

requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform cannot elect a statutory branch from a participant's unknown case
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the exact qualifying event - reversal, dismissal, nolle prosequi, successful diversion, conditional discharge, misdemeanor conviction, acquittal, or the no-felony-charge-within-one-year branch; confirm it with the certified court disposition and a New Mexico attorney if classification is uncertain

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Confirmed administrative center, destination, and accepted request format
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Confirmed administrative center, destination, and accepted request format
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the committed record expressly does not identify the receiving unit or its mechanics
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the exact office, address or portal, required format, attachments, and fee if any; confirm it with the New Mexico Department of Public Safety

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Certified disposition or sworn no-felony-charge affirmation
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Certified disposition or sworn no-felony-charge affirmation
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the required supporting proof is participant-specific and is not held
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the certified disposition for the selected branch, or the sworn affirmation if the receiving office confirms that branch and format; confirm it with the court clerk and the confirmed administrative center
